name: retrieval-smoke
note: S10 retrieval eval. Each case is a query plus the answer phrase a correctly-retrieved chunk must contain — graded with recall@k / MRR from @harbor/rag. This is the dataset that finally GRADES the S08 chunker choice (the chunker showdown). Learner lab: grow it to 20+ cases, including adversarial and ambiguous queries where the honest answer is 'refuse / ask a clarifying question' — the retrieval-threshold half of flaw #3 (no score floor) means the current system will confidently retrieve *something* for those; that's the bug S12 harvests.

cases.input: how long until the password reset link expires
how many times can I use a recovery code
how do I turn on two factor authentication
what is the airspeed velocity of an unladen swallow
